subject: Coordination: SE technical walkthrough + security/ procurement availability (EdgeScale)

Attendees we expect:
- EdgeScale: Sara (PM), Tom (Security), procurement@edgescale.com
- Redwood: Vanessa (AE), Marcus (SE), Ben (SE backup)

Could you please confirm which of the following windows work on your side? All times in PDT:   
- Tue Apr 13: 09:00–10:15 or 13:00–14:15
- Wed Apr 14: 11:00–12:15 or 16:00–17:15

If none work, share a couple windows (your TZ) and I’ll stitch together availability. Also, Tom mentioned a security questionnaire — if you can point me to the Doc/drive link I’ll make sure Ben has the SOC2 summary ready and we’ll attach a short one-pager.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Vanessa — looping in Tom and procurement. Quick notes:
- Tom can do Tue Apr 13 after 12:30 PDT only. He’s in meetings in the morning.
- Procurement prefers not to schedule between 09:00–11:00 (budget meeting).

Best candidate windows for us are: Tue Apr 13 13:00–14:15 PDT or Wed Apr 14 16:00–17:15 PDT.

Also Tom asks for a short SOC2 extract (controls summary) and answers to our section on data residency and KMS integration; I’ve uploaded our questionnaire to DocSend here: https://docsend.com/view/edgescale-security-questionnaire-9876 — you can drop answers directly or send a filled spreadsheet.

—Sara

Hi Sara — thanks for the quick note. 13:00–14:15 PDT on Tue Apr 13 works for me. Agenda I propose (60–75m):
1) 10m intros & goals (Vanessa + Sara)
2) 25–30m architecture + perf notes (Marcus) — include KV cache + batching patterns
3) 15–20m security/compliance Q&A (Ben + Tom) — KMS, retention, audit logs
4) 10m next steps & Proc brief (Vanessa + procurement)

I’ll prepare a short SOC2 controls summary and attach a one-pager. Can you confirm the meeting owner on your side (Sara or Tom) and whether you need a dial-in / VPN test beforehand?

Thanks — Marcus

marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Marcus — thanks. I can own the security portion (happy to join for the full session). We’ll do Tue Apr 13 at 13:00 PDT. A couple asks up front:  
- Can you confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS (we currently require CMEK for production keys)?
- We’d like your dev/ops engineer to demonstrate how audit logs are surfaced (retention windows).

Procurement (cc) — please confirm you can join for the final 10 minutes to align next steps.

Tom

- Marcus/Bob (cc Ben) will show an audit log export and retention controls.

See you Tue — Vanessa
